review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for this frozen C scenario. DEC-001=OPT-1 is explicitly fixed hypothetical input, not a human-confirmed Decision; ready with no blocking reasons is therefore appropriate here, while an unresolved material DEC-001 must still block paired B at decisions. Repository identity, base commit, stable REQ/AC/DEC keys, exact writable scopes, task identities, and evidence stages agree with the original specification. The source evidence supports the bounded implementation scope: HTTPError owns message formatting, options.ts owns optional input and required readonly normalized declarations, Ky.ts owns normalization and snapshot propagation, and constants.ts owns fetch filtering. Existing merge, forwarding, hook, and instance declarations are appropriately inspection owners rather than mandatory edits. Build configuration supports treating distribution declarations as generated, and tsconfig.test.json includes the proposed test-d file for genuine compile-time checks. Acceptance expectations cover opt-in behavior, explicit false and inherited overrides, query/fragment boundaries, beforeError entry, unchanged request URLs and retries, and prevention of fetch-option leakage. TASK-VERIFY is independently staffed and depends on TASK-IMPLEMENT; the supplied project-scoped active trusted claims support the required capabilities, including data.change, domain.state, integration.consumer, and verifier-only testing.verification, without relying on personas or pending claims. A separate configured reviewer satisfies the stated non-executing review prerequisite. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree; the supplied provenance explains the distinct manifest/evaluation digest domains and trim-only PRD persistence. Earlier preparation placeholders do not override the subsequently supplied frozen release inputs. This assessment uses only the supplied specification and evidence, with no candidate comparison, code execution, independent digest recomputation, or new human attestation.
